bank.keyText: Anaesthesia works safely at scale yet is not fully understood, with many targets and effects that come apart
choiceTexts: The lipid membrane theory has been replaced by a settled account built on one protein target
Anaesthesia carries hidden dangers that patients are never told about, and the profession has been slow to admit it
Anaesthesia works safely at scale yet is not fully understood, with many targets and effects that come apart
The main obstacle to understanding anaesthesia is that operating room monitors are not accurate enough

answer.text: Anaesthesia works safely at scale yet is not fully understood, with many targets and effects that come apart
answer.line: The passage opens on a safe drug no one can explain and closes on a condition the field cannot yet define.

steps: Read the frame first. Paragraph 1: remarkably safe, yet no one can say what anaesthesia is at the level of molecules.
Then the close: the field produces, on demand, "a condition it cannot yet define".
Check the middle: too many protein targets in paragraph 7, and effects that come apart, "Three effects, three doses, three places."
Only one choice holds all of it.

choices.text: The lipid membrane theory has been replaced by a settled account built on one protein target
choices.note: Half of it holds: the lipid theory did fall. But the field found too many protein targets, and the one clean result holds for one drug, not the state.

choices.text: Anaesthesia carries hidden dangers that patients are never told about, and the profession has been slow to admit it
choices.note: The passage calls anaesthesia remarkably safe and the gap a research program rather than a warning. Alarm is not its register.

choices.text: Anaesthesia works safely at scale yet is not fully understood, with many targets and effects that come apart
choices.note: Safe at scale, not understood, many targets, effects that come apart: the opening, middle and close in one line.

choices.text: The main obstacle to understanding anaesthesia is that operating room monitors are not accurate enough
choices.note: Monitors are the subject of one paragraph. Paragraph 14 blames the slow progress partly on redundant targets, not on instruments, and the main idea covers far more.

choices.text: Because different drugs act at different sites, anaesthetists ought to give only one agent at a time
choices.note: The passage never recommends one agent at a time. It describes practice as several drugs together and says the practice should not be unsettled.
